title: RSSHub before 2026.11.01-8521.e529e9b contains a domain validation bypass in the javdb routes that allows…
description: RSSHub versions before 2026.11.01-8521.e529e9b have a domain validation bypass vulnerability in the javdb routes. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to capture the operator's JAVDB_SESSION cookie by passing an absolute javdb.com URL in the category parameter and setting the domain query to an attacker-controlled host. The processItems function then sends the _jdb_session cookie to the attacker's domain.
